name: Homura Safety
description: Homura Safety is a calm, responsive WordPress theme designed for fire-safety compliance consultancies and workplace inspection services. Inspired by high-contrast technical publications, it features signature slanted bar hero typography, docked quick-link navigation, and structured findings report templates. Built with clean block layouts and accessible sans-serif typography, it delivers a clear, professional presentation for technical advisory firms.
